feedback: ACCEPT. Format: header block is complete and matches the paper layout (REWARD_MACHINE/STATES/INITIAL_STATE/FINAL_STATES/TRANSITION_FUNCTION/REWARD_FUNCTION); FINAL_STATES is nonempty (u5), u5 is declared in STATES and is accepting for the task since both entries into u5 are guarded by target_picked_up and u5 has only a self-loop. Semantic fidelity: the chain u0 -key_found-> u1 -has_matching_key-> u2 -(target_door_open & has_matching_key)-> u3 -(target_room_entered)-> u4 -(target_picked_up)-> u5 implements the required order find key -> open locked door -> get ball; the conditional 'should you find the key' is vacuous here because target_picked_up physically forces target_door_open, which forces has_matching_key, which forces key_found, so a linear chain accepts exactly the task-completing policies; has_matching_key and target_room_entered are environment-forced intermediates, legitimate as dense progress milestones. Ordered coverage and event safety: every state has an else self-loop covering irrelevant events; guards within each state are mutually exclusive; the !target_picked_up conjunct on u3->u4 correctly makes target_picked_up win at any (hypothetical) same-step entered+pickup valuation, preventing a stranded terminal reward of 0.1; same-step unlock coincidence is handled since the unlocking toggle necessarily leaves the key in hand, so target_door_open & has_matching_key fires exactly at the unlock step, and has_matching_key regressions (drop) are absorbed by the u2 else self-loop with re-establishment always possible while the RM is in u2. Latch handling is correct: key_found and target_room_entered are used only as one-way milestone triggers and their persistence never causes spurious refiring into wrong states (u1/u3 else loops absorb them). Reachability: all six states are reachable on the normal solve (u5 reached via u4 -> pickup), and u5 is reachable only on true task completion. Reward safety: all rewards nonnegative, paid at most once each, total bounded at 1.4, final 1.0 obtainable only via target_picked_up, no exploit path (else loops yield 0; no transition can be farmed since the machine never regresses). Minor non-blocking notes: (1) the transition (u3, target_picked_up) -> u5 is unreachable in this environment because target_room_entered necessarily turns true (and fires u3->u4) at least one step before any pickup, since the ball is reachable only from inside cells or the doorway and pickup does not move the agent - it is harmless defensive coverage and even if it fired the reward/destination would be correct; (2) the has_matching_key conjunct in the u2->u3 guard is redundant (the unlocking toggle implies carrying the key) but harmless and adds robustness; (3) six states is slightly above the minimal five (u2 or the u3/u4 split could be merged), but the extra states buy dense, correctly ordered shaping and introduce no incorrect transitions. No rewrites required.

Syntax is valid; generator scoping (b, y, c) is correct; all None accesses are guarded by short-circuiting checks; max(..., default=...) is valid Python; no imports, no action calls, no mutation of the environment or episode memory.
